944 // ===================== US-15: Display High Score (FR-15) =====================
945 // The BEST card is always shown next to the live SCORE card.
946 // - BEST shows max(stored best, live score), refreshed in the same tick the score changes.
947 // - As soon as the live score beats the stored best, a gold "NEW!" badge appears on the card
948 // (a tie is not a new best - same rule as FR-14).
949 // - After the session is saved, a restart shows the new stored best and the badge disappears.
950 class HighScoreDisplay {
951 public:
952 5 void setStored(int v) { stored_ = v; }
953 21 void update(int liveScore) { live_ = liveScore; } // call every tick, after the logic
954 14 int shown() const { return std::max(stored_, live_); }
955 14 bool newBest() const { return live_ > stored_; }
956 int stored() const { return stored_; }
957 private:
958 int stored_ = 0, live_ = 0;
959 };

1109 // ===================== US-17: Validate Reliability and Input Handling (NFR-3, SO-2, SEC-3, SEC-4) =====================
1110 // - Every key goes through commandForKey(); anything not used by the game becomes NONE and
1111 // is ignored - no key can crash or confuse the game (NFR-3, SO-2).
1112 // - Direction presses go into a small bounded queue (3 entries, SEC-3). Fast taps such as
1113 // UP then LEFT inside one 150 ms tick are both kept and applied on the next two ticks,
1114 // each checked against the move before it, so the snake still can never reverse into itself.
1115 // - checkInvariants() verifies the whole game state (bounds, no overlap, connected body,
1116 // grid in sync, food on a free cell, score == 10 x apples eaten).
1117 // - The soak test hammers the game with 200 000 random key presses (every SFML key), pauses,
1118 // restarts and frame stalls of up to 2 s, and checks the invariants after every step.
1119 // It also loads 300 random/corrupt high-score files.

1415 // NFR-7 - the game is split into the four layers of the SADS; each layer only calls the one below:
1416 // Presentation : InputHandler (SFML events -> commands), Renderer (GameSnapshot -> pixels)
1417 // Application : GameController (INTRO / RUNNING / PAUSED / GAME_OVER, tick timing, sessions)
1418 // Domain : GameEngine (grid, snake, food, score, rules) - no window, drawing or file code
